::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 24th [1869]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Mrs Curteis](people/person_2034.qmd)
I send the gains of Mrs Twitch and of the bits of correspondence.[^1] St Canace’s Jackdaw is in type waiting till he can get in, and I think the Story of a Dream will probably be in before Alec as it is so much shorter and I think it is <u>very</u> good

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Black-edged paper.
[^2]: 'Mrs. Twitch' was a story, signed R. L. C., published in *MP* (June 1869) 606-12, which gave rise to a query answered in (October 1869) 415.  Two later stories, also about Mrs Twitch and presumably by the same author, were 'Pin-Baskets' (June 1875) 639-646, and 'True and Just in All My Dealings' (September 1881) 300-3.  'St. Canace's Jackdaw' was a poem, published in *MP* (August 1869) 140-1.  The other stories mentioned have not been traced.
